message.content: No people are discernible in the scene. The image shows the Golden Gate Bridge, a large red suspension bridge spanning water, with a brick building (Fort Point) on the left, a small rock with a bird on it in the foreground, parked cars along the shoreline, and hills in the background. The only human-related detail is a few tiny, indistinct figures near the parked cars at the left edge, but they are too small and blurry to identify as people.
